lines: Hello... thank you for inviting me.
Hello! I am glad to see you.
Thank you for coming! I've been waiting for you. Here, have an ale!
Thank you for the warm reception!
Thank you for coming! Please, please... sit down, relax!
I greatly appreciate your kindness, sir.
Finally! Here's a flagon of ale... to your health!
Excellent! I have been looking forward to seeing you!
Hello! Goodness, what a wonderful place!
Welcome, welcome! I am so glad you've arrived!
Thank you for doing me this great favor! You will be my honored guest for as long as you wish to stay.
Thank you for your kind words. You are a wonderful host.
Oh! Thank you so much for coming.
No, the honor is mine. Thank you for the kind greeting.
I feel like I'm home again. This is great.
Good! Please, rest your weary feet.
Thanks very much. I owe you.
Fantastic! I'm glad to see that you've made it here in one piece.
Hello yourself! How have you been? Please, take off your armour and rest.
Greetings! It is a great honor to have you here!
Thank you for your kind words. I am flattered.
I have heard that you are a sage.
Ha! I know a thing or two, I suppose.
They told me that your strategy could defeat a god!
No, no, your praise is too great. I am but a mere mortal.
Your virtues have been extolled throughout the land!
Ah, well. I am lucky to have been blessed by righteousness.
You are said to be a very wise man.
Thank you, that is very flattering.
I have heard that your tactics are extraordinary.
They are only extraordinary when they work, my friend.
I wish to fight for the Hetmanate's common folk.
That is exceptionally generous of you.
